proof_requests: A clear, high-resolution photo of the brand and model name on the frame.
Close-up photos of the rear derailleur and the gears (cassette).
A video of the bicycle being ridden or the gears being shifted while the rear wheel is off the ground.
Clear photos of the brake pads and rim surfaces.
response.reason: The brand and model, which are the primary drivers of value for a sports bicycle, are unreadable due to the low quality of the single provided photo. Assessment of mechanical condition is also impossible without better imagery.
